notes: The picture no longer drifts to low quality: the bitrate controller took every hiccup of the viewer for a slow network and never gave the bitrate back on a still screen (a LAN session had dropped to 640x400 at 0.15 Mbit/s). The viewer now reports when a frame arrives, separately from decoding it, and the quality comes back by itself on a clear link. Copied files can be pasted on the other computer: they did arrive before, but Explorer offered no Paste. Update both computers.
